entities.summary: Nessma El Jadida, formerly known as Nessma TV and Nessma Rouge was a commercial TV channel based in Tunisia, targeting Tunisia and the Maghreb countries. It was 25% formerly owned by the Italian company Mediaset, controlled by Silvio Berlusconi.
